behaviour: editing a client sends cleared optional fields (company, e-mail, source, notes) as empty strings so they clear; adding still leaves empty ones out — reverse: change buildBody in client-form.component.ts

behaviour: a client sent to Trash by a merge shows the toast through the 409 body's messageKey, so src/app/pages/trash/** was not changed — reverse: drop messageKey from the CLIENT_MERGED response in generic.js and handle the code in the Trash page

behaviour: the profile falls back to the digits of `phone` when `phoneNormalized` is missing (staff do not receive it) so call and WhatsApp work for staff — reverse: use phoneNormalized only in client-profile.util.ts

behaviour: a merged client is only offered a pointer to its target when it is still in the loaded list; the generic list hides deleted clients, so a merged client normally shows client_not_found — reverse: add a server read of merged clients
